name: Kodama of the West Tree — modified creatures filter
notes: Memory: project_kodama_modified_creature_filter_2026-05-21. 'Modified creatures you control have trample' lost its 'modified' qualifier and applied to every creature. Only creatures with a counter, an Aura, or Equipment (CR 701.52) get trample.

scryfallData.name: Kodama of the West Tree
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Reach
Modified creatures you control have trample. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
Whenever a modified creature you control deals combat damage to a player, search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

scryfallData.name: Giant Spider
